name: Witchguard
summary: Witchguards are the sworn defenders of the White Witches of Irrisen.
replacesText: Class Skills; Hunter’s Bond; Endurance; Spells; Woodland Stride

features.name: Class Skills
features.summary: A witchguard adds Knowledge (nobility) and Sense Motive to his list of class skills, and removes Handle Animal and Knowledge (dungeoneering) from his list of class skills.

features.name: Defend Charge (Ex)
features.summary: At 4th level, a witchguard forms a bond with a spellcaster he has sworn to defend. Once per day, this bond allows the witchguard to spend a move action to grant an adjacent spellcaster a +2 dodge bonus to AC and a +2 circumstance bonus on concentration checks. At 5th level and every 5 levels thereafter, these bonuses increase by 2. The bonuses last for a number of rounds equal to the witchguard’s Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). At 4th level and every 3 levels thereafter, the witchguard can use this ability one additional time per day. This ability replaces hunter’s bond.

features.name: Bodyguard (Ex)
features.summary: At 3rd level, a witchguard gains Bodyguard APG as a bonus feat, even if he doesn’t meet the prerequisite. This ability replaces endurance.

features.name: Patron (Su)
features.summary: A witchguard learns something of arcane magic from the witches he defends. At 4th level, when a witchguard gains the ability to cast spells, he must also select a patron, as the witch class feature ( Pathfinder RPG Advanced Player’s Guide 70). This patron is usually the same as the patron of the witch he is sworn to protect, but the witchguard may choose any patron. The witchguard adds the first four spells from his patron’s spell list to his ranger spell list. The witchguard cannot cast patron spells of a level he is unable to cast.

features.name: Sworn Defender (Ex)
features.summary: At 7th level, a witchguard gains In Harm’s Way APG as a bonus feat. This ability replaces woodland stride.
